tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures jointly favor the archived siphon-memory ODE. The five pilot horizons span only 0.38–0.52, so additional temporal observations are more informative than fitting five parameters to five endpoints.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons provide little leverage to separate the memory timescale from the coupling strength. A close pilot fit would not establish reliable forecasts.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static siphon law or a one-state relaxation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither represents the coupled transient lag indicated by the pilot.
It does not measure the trajectory needed to distinguish memory relaxation from coupling.
